answer: Written in a checklist tone, short verdict at the end register, it stays short. The inlet is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the jetty. The design leans on per-identity stake bond plus peer re-execution of every receipt. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the falcon of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
